title: Output-aware Residual Stream Pruning for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.35579v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Residual stream pruning methods reduce inference cost by shrinking the model's hidden dimension, but existing approaches typically choose these dimensions by minimizing activation reconstruction error. This criterion implicitly treats all perturbation directions as equally important, ignoring the sensitivity of downstream layers. We introduce a sensitivity-aware approach to residual-stream pruning that directly accounts for this direction-dependent sensitivity. Using a second-order approximation to the output KL divergence, we characterize the effect of a residual-stream perturbation through both its activation covariance and the local sensitivity of the model output. The resulting subspace selection objective couples these two quantities, but is difficult to optimize directly. translated_title: 面向输出的残差流剪枝方法用于大语言模型
translated_abstract: 残差流剪枝方法通过收缩模型的隐藏维度来降低推理成本，但现有方法通常通过最小化激活重构误差来选择这些维度。这一准则隐含地将所有扰动方向视为同等重要，忽略了下游层的敏感性。我们提出了一种敏感性感知的残差流剪枝方法，直接考虑这种方向依赖的敏感性。通过对输出KL散度进行二阶近似，我们从激活协方差和模型输出的局部敏感性两方面来刻画残差流扰动的影响。由此得到的子空间选择目标将这两个量耦合在一起，但难以直接优化。我们推导出一个易于处理的谱上界，将子空间选择简化为对敏感性加权协方差矩阵进行特征分解，同时保留了……
tldr: 该论文提出一种敏感性感知的残差流剪枝方法，通过输出KL散度的二阶近似，将子空间选择简化为敏感性加权协方差矩阵的特征分解，从而在降低大语言模型推理成本时更好地保留模型输出质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sensitivity-aware residual stream pruning method that, via a second-order approximation of output KL divergence, reduces subspace selection to an eigendecomposition of a sensitivity-weighted covariance matrix, thereby better preserving model output quality while cutting large language model inference costs.
